sources.title: GitHub - fabiotosi92/ZipDepth: [ECCV 2026] Official implementation of ...
sources.snippet: ZipDepth is a lightweight zero-shot monocular depth estimation model that achieves the best accuracy-efficiency trade-off among lightweight methods, approaching transformer-based foundation models at a fraction of their cost. It combines reparameterizable convolutions (RepVGG), efficient channel and spatial attention (strip pooling and global context blocks), and a compact FPN decoder ...
